title: Payment methods on Zapp
text: Zapp accepts credit and debit cards, your Zapp wallet balance, and a linked bank account. To add or remove a payment method, go to Settings > Payments in the app, where you can also set one method as your default. Cards are securely tokenized, and Zapp never stores your full card number.
